model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect sizes for five different transformer language models—XLM-L₂ (light blue), mBERT-R₂ (green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red)—across nine linguistic categories: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis displays these linguistic categories in alphabetical order, while the vertical axis represents the “effect” on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10. Each linguistic category is represented by a group of five adjacent bars, one for each model, with error bars indicating variability. The approximate values for the bars are: for IE-Baltic, XLM-L₂ ≈ 2, mBERT-R₂ ≈ 3, XLM-R₂ ≈ 3, mBERT-B₂ ≈ 6, and XLM-B₂ ≈ 6; for IE-Germanic, XLM-L₂ ≈ 10, mBERT-R₂ ≈ 10, XLM-R₂ ≈ 10, mBERT-B₂ ≈ 14, and XLM-B₂ ≈ 14; for IE-Indic, XLM-L₂ ≈ 2, mBERT-R₂ ≈ 20, XLM-R₂ ≈ 18, mBERT-B₂ ≈ 23, and XLM-B₂ ≈ 21; for IE-Romance, XLM-L₂ ≈ 7, mBERT-R₂ ≈ 5, XLM-R₂ ≈ 5, mBERT-B₂ ≈ 12, and XLM-B₂ ≈ 8; for IE-Slavic family, XLM-L₂ ≈ 11, mBERT-R₂ ≈ 10, XLM-R₂ ≈ 1, mBERT-B₂ ≈ 17, and XLM-B₂ ≈ 15; for IE-other, XLM-L₂ ≈ 7, mBERT-R₂ ≈ 7, XLM-R₂ ≈ 1, mBERT-B₂ ≈ 9, and XLM-B₂ ≈ 9; for Isolate, all models show negligible effects (XLM-L₂ ≈ 0, mBERT-R₂ ≈ 0, XLM-R₂ ≈ 0, mBERT-B₂ ≈ 0, XLM-B₂ ≈ 0); for Semitic, XLM-L₂ ≈ 11, mBERT-R₂ ≈ 16, XLM-R₂ ≈ -2, mBERT-B₂ ≈ 14, and XLM-B₂ ≈ 20; and for Uralic, all models show negligible effects (XLM-L₂ ≈ 0, mBERT-R₂ ≈ 0, XLM-R₂ ≈ 0, mBERT-B₂ ≈ 0, XLM-B₂ ≈ 0). The bars are not sorted and are visually grouped by linguistic category, with no particular emphasis on any bar beyond their color coding and error bars.
